material: polar orthorhombic (Pca2_1) Hf1-xZrxO2 (x = Zr fraction); neutral oxygen vacancies; released by Taper, Cai, Strkalj, Monserrat and Di Martino (2026)
site_numbering: Oxygen sites are identified by their 0-based atom index in the CIF (oxygens are atoms 32-95).
vasp_protocol: VASP, PBE. Each vacancy energy is the total energy of the 96-atom supercell with one neutral O vacancy, ionic positions relaxed at the lattice of the CIF; pristine energies are those of the same supercells without a vacancy.

columns.O_index: 0-based atom index of the oxygen in HZO_x0.50_Hf16Zr16O64.cif
columns.E_vac: formation energy (eV) of a neutral vacancy at this site, as released in the authors' table
columns.mean_MO_distance: mean metal-oxygen distance (A) of the site
columns.angle_group: authors' grouping of the mean angle (109 or 120)

x050_site_table.note: Released by the authors for the x = 0.50 cell (their table FIGS12). The release does not state the oxygen chemical potential of E_vac.

castep_sets.note: CASTEP vacancy calculations in 96-atom 2x2x2 supercells for seven exchange-correlation functionals. Only the final enthalpy of each vacancy cell was released (no pristine-cell or reference energies). A purchase returns the enthalpy together with the authors' labels of that vacancy (vacancy type and local cation environment) and its fractional coordinates as released.

castep_333.note: CASTEP-PBE neutral vacancies in a 324-atom 3x3x3 supercell at x = 0.50 (final enthalpies only; no pristine-cell energy released). Sites are 0-based atom indices of this CIF.
